svg.title: Connectivity Credits demo architecture
svg.desc: React sends a reading to Express, which saves it and an outbox event in PostgreSQL. The publisher sends the event through Kafka. The worker reads the saved reading and active policy, then commits its decision, credit and audit together. The API returns stored results to React.
